claims.disproof_condition: 條件：MaxLinear 後續 10-Q 的 infrastructure 成長歸因不再含 optical 出貨，或寫明資料中心產品需求下滑、預付晶圓轉列減損。核查頻率：每季（10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註、重讀光模組 DSP 層（tech:optical_module_dsp）。
claims.statement: MaxLinear's 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30: first-half revenue ($306.0 million) was derived in part from high-speed optical interconnect solutions sold into optical modules for data-center, metro and long-haul networks; Q2 infrastructure revenue was $85.0 million, up 145% year on year and 50% of revenue, driven by higher shipment volumes of optical, high-performance analog and wireless backhaul products; working capital absorbed a wafer prepayment for rising demand for certain data center products. Supplier self-report; the optical portion is not split out and no customer or product is named.
